grid.prompt: PICK A CARD. SEE WHAT COUNTS.
category.cpu.name: CPU
category.cpu.caption: Brain power
category.cpu.rule: Core capacity earns up to 20 points; thread count adds up to 5. This measures concurrency, not processor speed.
category.memory.name: Memory
category.memory.caption: Room to multitask
category.memory.rule: Usable RAM: about 4 / 8 / 16 / 32 / 64 GiB earns 3 / 10 / 18 / 23 / 25 points. Free RAM does not affect your score.
category.disk.name: Disk
category.disk.caption: Space to build
category.disk.rule: NVMe earns 12, SSD 9, HDD 2. Capacity adds up to 8 points. Only the selected whole disk counts; no disk changes are made.
category.graphics.name: Graphics
category.graphics.caption: Pixel potential
category.graphics.rule: Intel or AMD earns 12; NVIDIA or hybrid earns 8; other detected graphics earns 3. Three points await functional validation.
category.network.name: Network
category.network.caption: Stay connected
category.network.rule: Physical Ethernet earns 4; Intel Wi-Fi earns 4, other Wi-Fi 2. Internal controller links are excluded. Two points await functional validation.
category.firmware.name: Firmware
category.firmware.caption: Boot readiness
category.firmware.rule: UEFI earns 3 points. Confirmed Secure Boot off adds 2. Unknown state earns no off-state points; reported settings keep their provenance.
